title: GOP Pushing for Paxton to Win in Texas
description:
Ray Washburne, the co-chair of the Republican midterm convention, said he expects Trump's super PAC, which has already given $10 million to Ken Paxton's Senate campaign in Texas, 'is going to come in with more money.'
